messages:
Alex K: Morning team — quick async check-in for SRE.
Alex K: Yesterday: updated SLO runbook for p99/p95 latency alerts, added clearer escalation steps and a small playbook for noisy flaps. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/234
Priya M: Reviewed PR, left one nit about step ordering and a note to add a small test for the suppression window.
Jason L: Yesterday: addressed noisy nginx 502 alerts from a misconfigured readiness probe. Deployed a fix to prod-canary. Issue: INF-4887
Amanda R: Blocker: seeing intermittent p99 spikes on embedding-service across prod shards. Spikes correlate with bursts of long requests. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/d/embeds/p99-latency
oncall-bot: ALERT: embedding-service p99 latency >= 1200ms for 5m — incident 1769
Chris T: @Jason L any rolling node maintenance that could explain this?
Jason L: No scheduled drains. I initiated a canary restart on prod10 to test. Watching logs now.
Priya M: Today: will run the new runbook end-to-end in staging and validate PagerDuty suppression rules.
Alex K: FYI I'm going to roll a small config change at 11:15 to reduce default batch_size on our GPU pool to try to reduce tail latency.
Amanda R: Copy — I'll watch the embedding dashboard and post updates.
Jason L: Quick ask: can reviewers look at PR #457 (alerting backoff fix)? small change to reduce flapping.
Chris T: Reviewed and approved. :white_check_mark:
Alex K: Note for postmortem: add a line about KV-cache expiry causing short bursts of higher latency when cache misses spike.
Amanda R: Update: digging into logs, seeing a handful of 500s from model-runtime around the spikes. Opening INF-4890 and attaching the logs.
Priya M: If 500s are model-runtime, maybe a quant mismatch or model oom — tagging eng-ml for visibility. @eng-ml please advise.
Jason L: Proposal: add a temporary suppression for known deploy flaps for 10m during rollouts to reduce noisy pages. We can make it opt-in per rollout.
Alex K: Agree. Add a playbook step: "suppress pager for 10m on rollout". I'll open a tiny PR to the runbook.
deploy-bot: deploy finished: embedding-service v2.3.1 -> prod (canary: prod10)
oncall-bot: RESOLVED: incident 1769 — latency returned to baseline after canary restart and batch_size tweak
Alex K: Thanks all. Plan: if canary stays green at +15m, I merge the rollforward and schedule a full rollout.
Amanda R: No further blockers from monitoring. Dashboard looks stable.
Priya M: I'll take post-merge watch and validate suppression rules are behaving as expected.
Jason L: I'll follow up on INF-4887 this afternoon and link any findings to the runbook.
Alex K: Quick reminder: please pin the SLO dashboard to the channel for the week so on-call can find it fast.
Amanda R: Pinned.
Alex K: End of async. If anything changes reply here or ping oncall.

# quick healthcheck command for reference:
```
curl -sS https://embedding-service.prod.health/ready | jq .status
```
